newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE -- Mississippi GOs.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE -- Mississippi GOs.

text.p: Finance Act Issue, 1997 Series A Through H)

Sealed Bids will be received at the offices of the Department of Finance and Administration, 901 Walter Sillers Building, 550 High Street, Jackson, Mississippi 39201, until 11:00 o'clock a.m., Central Daylight Savings Time, on
for the purchase at not less than par plus accrued interest to the date of delivery of $7,660,000 aggregate principal amount General Obligation Bonds (Mississippi Small

Enterprise Development Finance Act Issue, 1997 Series A Through H) (the Bonds'') of the State of Mississippi (State''). The Bonds will be dated and bear interest from August 1, 1997, payable on February 1 and August 1 of each year, commencing February 1, 1998, and will be delivered in eight (8) separate Series as fully registered Bonds. The Bonds will mature on August 1 of each year, beginning August 1, 1998, and ending August 1, 2012, in the amounts as set forth in the Preliminary Official Statement. The Bonds will be subject to redemption prior to their respective

maturities, at the option of the State on and after August 1, 2002, in the manner set forth in the Preliminary Official Statement. The Bonds will also be subject to mandatory redemption prior to their respective maturities, at the principal amount thereof together with accrued interest to the date of redemption plus a premium of three percent (3%) in the event of a determination of taxability as described in the State's Preliminary Official Statement; or at par in the event of damage, destruction or condemnation of a Project funded with proceeds from the Bonds. The complete Notice of Bond Sale, the Preliminary Official Statement and an Official Bid Form on which all bids must be submitted and further information concerning the Bonds may be obtained from the Office of the State Treasurer at 404 Walter Sillers Building, 550 High Street, Jackson,
Mississippi 39201, Telephone: (601) 359-3600, Attention: Ms. Liz Majure or from the Department of Finance and

Street, Jackson, Mississippi 39201, Telephone: (601) 359- 3433, Attention: Ms. Mary Keen, which complete Notice of Bond Sale, Preliminary Official Statement and the Official Bid Form should be reviewed by bidders prior to submitting a bid. Bidders may not rely on this Summary Notice of Bond Sale as to the complete information concerning the Bonds.
